9012341.plot: Jonas inherits a failing current in the northern islands and, with the help of Wren, tries to keep it open for one more year.

9425856.plot: When a river goes missing from the valley, Odile and Cedric have one week to find it before the season turns.
9425856.tag: Invented tagline for Voyage of Strangers.

9048994.plot: Ilse returns to Lindqvist Bay after twenty years and finds the circuit still standing, but nobody will say who keeps it running.

9809883.plot: Invented synopsis for the prototype: Talia and Milo cross Port Ellery in search of the last working ember.
9809883.tag: Invented tagline for The Hollow Letter.

9678813.plot: When a promise goes missing from the northern islands, Kian and Dalia have one week to find it before the season turns.

9821231.plot: Bea inherits a failing cathedral in a small mountain town and, with the help of Nadia, tries to keep it open for one more year.

9475673.plot: When a harbor goes missing from a small mountain town, Linus and Zelda have one week to find it before the season turns.

9343139.plot: Bea returns to the northern islands after twenty years and finds the meridian still standing, but nobody will say who keeps it running.
9343139.tag: Invented tagline for The Weightless Parade.
